visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Struct Is Passed by Value
visualizerParams.problemDescription: scale should turn a 4 x 3 rectangle into 12 x 9, but the program still prints 4 x 3.

solution.explanation: Passing a struct by value copies it, so the function scales its private copy and the caller's rectangle never changes. Pass its address (struct Rect *) and use -> to change the original.
